roll.guideLocked: Your fixed rate is locked only until the Boros positions <hi>mature</hi>. A roll closes those Boros positions and reopens the same pair at a later maturity. <hi>Your perps never move.</hi>
roll.guideEdge: That is the gain: a new position pays <hi>two perp entry fees plus slippage on the full notional</hi>. A roll pays none of it, only Boros trade fees on the Boros positions. Same spread, <g>higher APR on your capital.</g>
roll.whenLastDays: <hi>In the last {{days}} days.</hi> Rolling early lets you <g>enter the longer maturity in parts</g>: several entries at different rates instead of one, which smooths the rate you lock.
roll.whenPaysMore: <hi>When the next maturity pays more</hi> than you earn now, after the round trip's fees. The banner says so when it does.
roll.whenMatures: <hi>Right when it matures</hi>, if you want to keep farming. If you do not roll, your perps stay unhedged on floating funding.
roll.notRolling: Not rolling is fine: closing both perps ends the position. If you do neither, the perps stay open with no fixed rate.
